The source starts at 100. To keep the next round at 100 units we need  
\(2(100‑x)+5 \ge 100\).  
Solving gives \(x \le 52.5\), so the largest whole number that guarantees the next round still has 100 units is 52.

SAFE_TOTAL: 52  
REQUEST: 52
